Question
========
What does the library `numpy` typically provide when doing data analysis?

Answerlist
-----------
* Graphical user interface windows
* High-level plotting tools only
* Efficient arrays and matrix operations
* A database management system
* A word-processing interface
* Web-scraping functionality

Solution
========
NumPy provides efficient arrays and numerical operations for data analysis.
